name: Creek Beach Grove
paymentPlan: 10% down payment at the sales launch, 60% during construction, and 30% upon handover
overview: Creek Beach Grove, developed by Emaar Properties, represents the pinnacle of waterfront luxury in Dubai Creek Harbour. This masterfully designed residential community offers one- to three-bedroom apartments set amidst pristine beachside landscapes. With contemporary architecture, thoughtfully planned layouts, and a host of world-class amenities, Creek Beach Grove presents an unmatched lifestyle that combines modernity, elegance, and leisure. Set against the backdrop of Dubai’s sparkling waters, this development provides residents with an immersive experience of coastal living while remaining connected to the city’s vibrant heartbeat.
